## 主张 Claim

在一个保护对增益的情境中，J2 的排序满足无损生成比较 C，并且从不以任何数量的次级增益交换受保护的基本条件；另有满足 C 的标量排序会交换，因此 J2 不能由 G0 与 C 推出；每一个满足 C 的自然数评分都会在有限增益处交换，因而没有这样的评分能表示 J2 在此情境中的判断。 / In one protection-versus-gains situation, J2's ordering satisfies the no-loss generative comparison C and never trades the protected basic condition for any number of secondary gains. A scalar ordering also satisfying C does trade, so J2 does not follow from G0 and C. Every natural-number score satisfying C trades at some finite number of gains, so no such score represents J2's verdict here.

Canonical source: [ProtectionPriorityRival.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/ProtectionPriorityRival.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 单一情境：选项 0 保住基本条件、无增益；选项 k>0 失去它并实现 k 项生成增益。基本条件不算作新的生成内容。 / A single situation: option 0 retains the basic condition with no gain; option k>0 loses it and realizes k generative gains. The basic condition is not counted as new generative content.
- C 取自 GenerativeComparison.ComparisonPrinciple；J2 取自 PracticalJudgment.Better；G0 只用于承认增益的正面意义。 / C is GenerativeComparison.ComparisonPrinciple; J2 is PracticalJudgment.Better; G0 is used only to recognize gains as positively relevant.

受保护条件确属基本、各项增益确为同一历史中实现的生成内容，须由对应条件 E 及分类论证支持；选项是同一历史的不同接续，不是独立所有者的持有。 / That the protected condition is basic and each gain is generative content realized in the same history requires correspondence E and a classification argument; options are continuations of one history, not holdings of independent owners.

只检查一个情境构造与自然数评分类；不证明 J2 在其他情境中正确、受保护条件确属基本，或有界敏感性对手不成立。 / Checks one situation and the natural-number score class only; it does not show that J2 is right elsewhere, that the protected condition is basic, or that bounded-sensitivity rivals fail.
